brief: Rebuild the paper processor around removable vessels and interchangeable guides, for a user-confirmed 102 mm Fuji roll, 16:9 and wider images plus a sacrificial finger-grip strip, all printable on the A1 mini. Implement the six accepted design recommendations, research Amazon.de terrarium mats and provide a suitable holder, update the local parametric viewer and print bundle, verify and deliver through a GitHub PR.
requirements: Two removable single-piece vessels in independent joining bases, with close parallel paper slots and independent emptying and cleaning
Removable, positively located paper guide with interchangeable slit clearances, shallow drip return and no tongs
Image dimensions drive the vessel and roll cut length; preserve a finger grip above the rim and a sacrificial trim band
Defined vertical and lateral agitation travel, immersed image at the top of the stroke, and dynamic headroom
Simple open-top filling when the guide is removed, rounded connected side well with a small visible fill cue
A/B visual and tactile identification on vessels, guides and cradle
Chemistry recipes independent of geometry; whole-ml components sum exactly to working volume
Research mat wattage, actual dimensions, installation restrictions, Amazon.de availability, mounting and temperature measurement
All printable parts and selected panorama presets fit the A1 mini in their documented print orientation
Local web viewer exposes v2 parameters, assembly and print plates, fill/paper previews, real slicer estimates and downloads
Meaningful geometry, clearance, volume, insertion/removal, agitation and print-orientation checks; wet validation remains explicitly outstanding
Current print bundle, concise assembly/use/heating instructions, CI and a non-draft GitHub PR

decisions.roll_width_evidence: User confirmed 10.2 cm, definitely not 12.7 cm, on 2026-10-20
decisions.orientation_proposal: Print each tall narrow vessel leaning about 44 degrees, preserving one-piece liquid containment. Verify by mesh bounds and slicing before claiming success.
decisions.v1_baseline: af78247 on origin/main after merging checked PR 1
decisions.heating: One 140 x 150 mm, 5 W mat per chamber; independent plates and power adjustment, no thermostat or permanent probe. Prewarm to 35-38 C and measure equilibrium. Evaluate with water before redesigning for more power.
decisions.capacity: About 30 complete 102 x 208 mm cuts per fresh pair of 325 ml ADOX RA-4 fills, by published area capacity.

milestones.core_cad: Removable vessels and guides, parallel slots 70 mm apart, repeatable bases and links, independent small-mat plates, two guard panels per chamber, clamps, edge keepers, side strap anchors and cable saddles.
milestones.geometry: Expanded checks cover both image aspects, small-mat orientations, fitting clearance, independent vessel removal and adjacent modules.
milestones.slicing: Standard set has 17 plate types, including four copies of the guard tile and two copies of each per-chamber heater fitting plate. Optional guides and fit piece remain available.
milestones.heater_research: INVITAL 5 W 140 x 150 mm is the user-supplied dimensional reference. Listing has a manual power dial and glass-only installation guidance; suitability for the printed vessel remains unresolved.
milestones.viewer: v2 at 127.0.0.1:8765, with assembly/exploded/inspection/print plates, source-derived parameters, working liquid and paper, real Bambu estimates, downloads and about 30-print ADOX capacity estimate.
milestones.validation: Geometry and viewer checks are run for each update; previous vessel support-path validation remains applicable because the wet vessels and their print orientation are unchanged.
milestones.delivery: Compact 5 W modules supersede the shared-heater layout in PR 4. Current instructions and print bundles use independent small mats.

physical_validation_remaining: Verify the chosen heater is suitable for this mounting and printed vessel; a metal spreader alone does not establish compatibility.
Measure actual heater mat thickness and check edge keeper/cable placement.
Print the fit section, guide and clip; test wet scrap paper, free agitation and emulsion contact.
Water-test vessels, fill cue, drainage, support removal and repeated independent vessel release.
Measure both loaded bath temperatures and use the established experimental timing.
